name: Mihir Gediya
tagline: I build retrieval, RAG, and production LLM systems that actually ship.
summary: AI/ML engineer with 3+ years building production systems that combine retrieval, LLMs, and classic ML. Comfortable from the embedding layer up to the product surface — vector stores, RAG pipelines, evaluation harnesses, and the Python/Java services that host them.

bullets: Built retrieval-augmented features over spend data using vector search and LLM re-ranking.
Designed evaluation harnesses for prompt and model changes to guard production quality.
Shipped Python services on AWS with Redis and Kafka to serve low-latency AI endpoints.
Built telemetry and anomaly-detection pipelines for RAN components.
Owned Java microservices and contributed to a Python ML inference layer.
Shipped observability improvements that cut on-call noise meaningfully.
Backend services for an automotive data platform using GraphQL and Spring Boot.
Contributed to the vehicle-event ML classification pipeline.
Owned AWS-backed ingestion handling millions of events.
Worked on satellite image processing pipelines and ML segmentation models.
Published an internal report on hyperspectral classification results.

education.detail: CGPA 3.92/4.3. Focus on applied ML, information retrieval, distributed systems.
First Class with Distinction (CPI 8.87/10). Capstone on GPI.
